question: Which synthetic aromatic organic compound inhibits the chemical breakdown of food that occurs in the presence of oxygen, commonly used in foods such as crackers, microwave popcorn, butter and chicken nuggets?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tertiary butyl hydroquinone**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tertiary butyl hydroquinone (TBHQ) is a synthetic aromatic organic compound that extends the shelf life of foods by inhibiting oxidation.
 
• It is a form of butane (hydroquinone) that is used to preserve food fats and oils, preventing them from becoming rancid.
 
• TBHQ is commonly found in processed foods such as crackers, microwave popcorn, butter, and chicken nuggets to maintain freshness.
 
• Though effective as a preservative, its usage is regulated due to health concerns when consumed in large amounts.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
